title: Proper-Arc Registered Summaries: Lean 4 Companion
description:
Lean 4 companion to Registered Proper-Arc Chains and Placement Fibers in a Circular Collapse System (hal-05848115v1). For all n >= 3, source offsets c, and 2 <= r < n, the sources prove the classification of actual registration origins, actual selected chains, placement fibres, complete generated summaries, and exact and refined finite counts.

The archive contains the proof sources, exact generic upstream mirrors, pinned toolchain and Lake lock, nine frozen reports, the theorem-to-source map, and the completed isolated cold-replay evidence. Final acceptance is bound to that cold-replay receipt: all nine owning validators and 94 tests passed with newly acquired sources and a fresh official Mathlib compiled cache. The source manifest records the exact SHA-256 bindings.

This software companion does not include the later fixed-pair actual-type specialization or the generating-function/asymptotic formalization. It is separate from the HAL paper's publication identity.
